title: Long error messages are cut off in tooltips due to lack of wrapping
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 760M (radeonsi, gfx1103_r1, LLVM 19.1.1, DRM 3.57, 6.8.0-63-generic) - AMD Ryzen 5 7640U w/ Radeon 760M Graphics (12 threads) ### Issue description The error message is too long (even when hovering over it, see image), so it is cut off. It has to be copied and pasted somewhere else. Also signal parameters (and their types) are not checked in the editor, only at runtime. Is this something that can/should be done? I'll open another issue if that's the case. ### Steps to reproduce - Define a signal with a parameter (with a longer name, depending on effective resolution) - Connect it to a function with a parameter (also with a longer name if needed) - Emit the signal (without parameters) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A but here's an example for convenience: ```gdscript extends Node signal tested_long_signal_name(value: bool) func _ready() -> void: tested_long_signal_name.connect(error_too_long) error_too_long(true) func error_too_long(_value: bool) -> void: tested_long_signal_name.emit() ``` Result: ``` E 0:00:00:652 node.gd:10 @ error_too_long(): Error calling from signal 'tested_long_signal_name' to callable: 'Node(node.gd)::error_too_long': Method expected 1 arguments, but called with 0. core/object/object.cpp:1249 @ emit_signalp() node.gd:10 @ error_too_long() node.gd:7 @ _ready() ```
